*** COSTUME / HAIR / MAKEUP — Infantry ***
Soldiers: Artillery, Brigade, Infantry — Costume (you provide): Black Seamless Tights, Black Camisole Leotard Male Soldiers: Black T-shirt, Black tights; Shoes: Black Ballet Shoes; Makeup: Light Stage Makeup; Hair: High Bun, No Part; Accessories (BA provides): White Gloves; Prop (BA provides): Brown gun
Light Stage Makeup Instruction Sheet:
• Powder matching skintone
• Light brown eye shadow applied to the crease with an eye shadow brush
• Dark Brown/Black eyeliner and black mascara. No fake lashes.
• Blush on the cheeks (be sure to apply plenty so dancer doesn’t look washed out in the stage lights)
• Red or Dark Red lipstick
Dancers of Color may wear flesh tone tights and flesh tone ballet shoes.
Costume Care Guidelines:
• Handle costume pieces with care while changing to prevent damage to delicate fabrics
• Promptly notify Ballet Arkansas in the event of costume damage at the point of discovery, no matter how significant
• Never throw costumes or accessories on the floor, or hang costumes by their elastic straps
• Refrain from sitting on the floor while in costume
• Do not attempt to alter, mend, clean, or launder any costume or accessory
• Never apply stage make-up while in costume and shall take great care to refrain from smudging make-up on costume during its removal
• Refrain from the use of spray perfume or cologne while in costume
• Never wear any garment not assigned to cast member
• Do not handle or consume food or beverage while in costume, with the exception of water
• Do not remove costumes from their assigned dressing rooms or from the theater
• Remove all bobby pins used to secure head pieces and wigs following their use
• Return all headpieces to their assigned bags
• Comply fully with any and all updates to Ballet Arkansas’ wardrobe policies
• Do not pack markers, paints, colored drinks or anything that may damage or stain costumes.
